SessionManager — per-user OrchestratorAgent lifecycle + multi-channel tracking.

A session belongs to a UserId (internal UUID), not to a channel. The same session is reused when the user messages from any linked channel. channels tracks which (ChannelKind, raw_id) pairs are associated with this session — used for ctl session list.
